name: get_air_quality
description: Check current air quality at a location (latitude/longitude or city name, e.g., "40.7128, -74.0060" or "New York"). Returns US AQI score, PM2.5, PM10, CO, NO2, and ozone levels.

name: get_forecast
description: Get hourly air quality forecast for a location. Returns US AQI, PM2.5, and PM10 predictions. Use to plan activities or alert users to upcoming poor air conditions.
